presentation.title: Generate images on your own machine.
presentation.description: One bounded prompt runs on your local backend — ComfyUI or any OpenAI-compatible image server. Approve each send; output stays local and untrusted until you review it.

Base prompt, negative prompt, variants, and production notes.
